sampling: Paired iid uniform draws inside declared parameter ranges. Not experimental confidence intervals. No aggregate score across conflicting objectives.
scope_note: Seventeen selected parameters including effective-liquid active fraction, transition temperature and mobility gain. Permeability remains fixed at 3.75e-14 m2, inlet atmosphere and oxygen reference fixed; liquid latent contrast and transition width fixed. Eight paired samples do not prove all-parameter, phase-model, permeability-range or low-oxygen robustness. Previous ensembles remain historical.
